content: SQL:2011 / Postgres application-time UPDATE FOR PORTION OF intersects the target period, then inserts zero to two temporal leftovers covering old_history minus targeted_history. Bitemporal leftovers are new rows at current system time. Analog only: Kutha must invalidate the whole original Fact at patch TT (losers remain) rather than mutate its VT in place, so old TT still sees the unsplit version.
